[h3][b]To celebrate the release, "GSpot Master" will be available at 50% off for 14 days, from March 25 at 10:00 AM to April 8 at 10:00 AM (PDT)![/b]

[b]“Re: GSpot Master”[/b] – A brand-new title set in the world of GSpot Master is about to be officially released! 
This time, you will play as Tang Ming Han, a handyman of the Yunu Clan, in pursuit of the ultimate secret manual "Acupressure King Fist", aiming to overthrow the martial arts world!​

[h3][b]Enhanced Acupoint Combat – Master the Art of Precision![/b][/h3]
Strike with precision, plan your moves, and outmaneuver your foes! With even stronger opponents this time, can you fully grasp the power of GSpot Master and dominate the battlefield?

This time, even more captivating women await your conquest! From the gentle and obedient maid, the emotional junior disciple, to the enigmatic and alluring leader—each one with her own secrets waiting to be unraveled!

Delicate brushstrokes, soft hues, and breathtaking watercolor-style visuals bring every scene to life! With more refined character designs and smoother animations, immerse yourself in a world like never before!


Return to the martial world now—[b]add to your wishlist immediately[/b]![/h3]

notes.title: Good News!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35977978/eb3b2a6ad950fdc3382345018893c9e873355596.jpg[/img]
Thank you all for your great support for our "GSpotMaster"!!!!

Finally, with our struggle with translation, English version stroyline has been released. Once again, we proudly present our story to you guys. Also, if you are more familiar with Simplified Chinese, now you can press the button on the top right corner of stage menu to switch between the three version.

We keep the Chinese characters on the level selection scrolls to keep our flavor going. The number below the scrolls still represents your current progress of the stage in case you get lost.

If you have any other questions, please feel free to post them in the community center. Another project of the team, " Re:Gals Panic ", will hit the shelves on the afternoon of 26th. I hope you guys can enjoy it. :)
